Question Choices: How many sides does a pentagon have?
Hints: Use the polygon name to identify its number of straight sides.
Solution: A pentagon has five straight sides. The prefix penta means five.

Question Choices: Which shape is a quadrilateral? (A) Triangle (B) Square (C) Pentagon : A B C
Hints: Count the straight sides of the closed shape.
Solution: Choose B. A square has four straight sides; a triangle has three and a pentagon has five.

Question Choices: Select. Is a rectangle a quadrilateral? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Count the straight sides of the closed shape.
Solution: Yes. A rectangle has four straight sides and is therefore a quadrilateral.

Question Choices: What is special about a rhombus? (A) All sides are equal (B) All sides are curved (C) It has 3 sides : A B C
Hints: Check pairs of parallel sides, equal sides and right angles. A shape can belong to more than one family.
Solution: Choose A. All four sides of a rhombus are equal.

Question Choices: If lines would never cross even if extended, what do we call them?
Hints: Think about whether the complete lines could ever meet.
Solution: Lines in the same plane that never meet, even when extended, are parallel.
